text:
A date literal in a question must stand alone: 2026-09-01-plan.md is a note name, not a day

temporal-query.ts SINGLE_DAY and RANGE use lookarounds so nothing word-like or a hyphen may touch the date; before that, asking about a dated note name filtered that very note out. A further date after a range is refused as ambiguous, never left as a lexical token.

Quoted spans are extracted before the period is recognised; a stopword-only phrase matches adjacently only

pg-w2l/query runs extractPhrases on the whole question and temporalQuery on the rest, so a quoted last week is a phrase someone wrote, not a filter. A phrase with no content words (all stopwords) has nothing to look for in the keyword bag, so it can only match adjacently in a name, title, or heading. Both sides of the adjacency check go through phraseText, the same fold and punctuation strip.

Every process that touches the spool resolves it the same way; MNEME_SPOOL and MNEME_SOCK are honoured everywhere

The hook honoured the env overrides while the dogfood sweep and --status hardcoded ~/.mneme, so a relocated spool was never swept. resolveSpoolDir and resolveSockPath in buffer-path.ts own the rule now; listen.ts, tray.ts, remember.ts and the hook agree. A review finding, not a design choice.

A packet id names a spool file, so it must be one path segment: remember --id ../x could write outside the spool

assertPacketId in remember.ts enforces the hook's id alphabet [A-Za-z0-9._-] with no leading dot and basename equality, in both agentNote and spoolPacket. A NUL byte cannot even be passed through a spawn, so that case is pinned in-process.

Spool files are written under .tmp and renamed into place; the sweep filters on .json

hook.mjs and remember.ts write to id.json.tmp then renameSync, so a sweep running at the same moment (the listener's every five seconds, or an operator's dogfood) never reads a half-written packet and sidelines it as .bad. A .bad file can be retried by removing the suffix.

Clip strings by code points, never by UTF-16 units: sensory.ts clipTitle and display.ts clip spread the string first

line.slice(0, 120) can split an emoji into a lone surrogate and persist an ill-formed title. The tests check a UTF-8 round trip because String.prototype.isWellFormed is newer than the tsconfig lib target.

A test that asserts a file is absent must name a file some code path could write

cli.spec once checked traces/status.json, which nothing ever writes, so the assertion could never fail; it now snapshots the traces directory before and after. The same lens found the hook-snippet test encoding the unquoted path it was meant to catch.

How the review was run: five finder lenses over the diff, three refuters per finding, one completeness critic

Correctness, governance, determinism, docs consistency, and test hermeticity each read git diff origin/main...HEAD and reproduced what they claimed; twenty-five unique findings, all real on reproduction. The governance and determinism lenses found the fewest bugs and the sharpest fences; the docs lens found the most drift. Run it before a PR, not after.
